text: I was here for a routine dental cleaning. This is was my second time in Thailand, but it was the first time in this clinic. The experience was perfect, and more professional compared to the clinic I tried in Bangkok. The price for me was 900 TBH, however, it depends based on the time it takes. I can recommend ‚Smile Line‘ as an expat living here in Chiang Mai.

restaurant_name: Smile Line Dental Clinic Chiang Mai
text:
I'm from England and wanted some work done whilst away travelling, as I am getting married this year, I wanted a smile make over as ive always struggled with sticky out front teeth.
I asked advice for my solution without having a brace. The lady dentist talked through with me, what I could do, and gave prices upfront.
I ended up having 8 veneers made, with many impressions and x rays,
2 new crowns and fillings.
All for about £2500 pounds ( 1 veneer in UK is about £700 )
I went back about 4 times to get all the work done, within my time frame in Chiang Mai.
The dentist herself was very soft handed, and she definitely knkws what shes doing, also was open to listen if I asked for a small adjustment.
I can honestly say, I am thrilled with my results, and can't wait to have a beaming smile now at my wedding. Would definitely recommend any foreigners looking for quality work, to use Smile Line.

restaurant_name: Smile Line Dental Clinic Chiang Mai
text:
Overall a great experience.
Had an initial free appointment to check what was wrong or needed doing. There was a receptionist that spoke English on the desk and I booked my appointment time through their Facebook page with no problem.
I had 2 very small fillings which took no more than 20 mins. The dentist spoke an intermediate amount of English but explained everything to me slowly and in a friendly way. I was incredibly nervous as I've never had any work at the dentist before but they all tried to calm me down and let me listen to my headphones while the procedure took place.
I also had the option of having a numbing injection or not, which I decided to take.
There was around 4 nurses in the room with me as well which was reassuring.
The dentist's room looked exactly like the ones in the UK and of course everything looked clean and sterile.

It's great that you can have a free consultation as this is a chance to look around a decide if you're comfortable with the place.
I also had an X-ray done of my teeth which I could take home and cost around £10.

Overall I would definitely come back to this dentist. It might have been slightly more expensive that others but for me I wanted a western standard dentist with staff who spoke English.

restaurant_name: Smile Line Dental Clinic Chiang Mai
text:
I had a mixed experience here.

The Good:

Nice reception and the dentist was very fair in recommending a cheaper procedure that delivers similar results (gel whitening vs lazer) .

The Bad:

Too many people in the surgery room. I guess some like this, I do not. Felt like I was in the middle of a training exercise.

The Dentist cut the inside of my mouth when she vigorously ripped the sharp teeth mould from my mouth. I told her this and she appeared to act like I was mistaken? Few days later and mouth ulcer confirmed I wasn't.

Supposed to go back for a filling but will go elsewhere. Dentist a little too heavy handed for me and I wasn't comfortable.
